about: The RemoteFM1 releases the web installer offers, newest first (index.html installs the first). sha256 is the default package's (firmware/remote-X.Y.Z.fwsc), as firmware/SHA256SUMS lists it; usbOnly, when there, is the release's second package (no Bluetooth), which the page offers as a choice. identity is what the package installs as (the page checks it). test_installer.mjs checks that this list, SHA256SUMS and the files agree, and the page checks the SHA-256 again in the browser before any write.

notes: Recording from the FM-1 over USB works: 0.2.1 and 0.2.2 sent mostly silence to a computer recording the FM-1's USB audio input.
Playing to the FM-1 over USB, Bluetooth and the screen are unchanged from 0.2.2.
Tested on an FM-1 on 2026-10-28: a test tone played to the FM-1 and recorded back, continuous and clean.
Bluetooth about 6x faster: the radio now uses 2M, long link packets, 244-byte writes and a 7.5 ms interval (measured with a Mac: about 35 KB/s, was about 6).
Over Bluetooth each screen change appears whole: the old screen stays until the new one has arrived, so no half-drawn pages or numbers.
Hosts (this site's player, fm1remote) pace and simplify the screen for Bluetooth; USB is unchanged.
Tested on an FM-1 on 2026-10-27 with ChoralRoot in this site's player over Bluetooth, and over USB.
Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp (MPL-2.0) instead of TransitFM1's platform.
Bluetooth MIDI: the panel and the screen without a cable. The screen is slower that way (a few KB/s): fine for a still screen, not for a moving one.
USB audio: the computer plays through the FM-1's speaker or headphones, and MASTER is the volume.
Answers installers as itself, FM-1_52000201, on the USB device "FM-1" (0.1 answered as the official V15).
REC held at power-on enters the chip's own USB update mode (0.1's key was OCT-). fm1-base's safeguards: the boot guard, the crash screen, the watchdog.
Writes 0xF2000..0xF3FFF (Bluetooth's address) at its first Bluetooth start, and 0xFC000.. only when you calibrate the panel. The USB-only package has no radio.
Tested on an FM-1 on 2026-10-27: both packages, and the way out to ChoralRoot 0.27 and back.
The FM-1 as a USB panel: its keys, buttons, knobs and MASTER go to the computer as MIDI; the computer draws its screen and lights its LEDs.
Makes no sound by itself: a firmware running on the computer (this site's player, FM1VST, fm1remote) plays.

New in 0.1.1: a firmware whose image is larger than the app area (Baud Girl's can be) is refused before anything is written, by the FM-1 and by its update loader; 0.1 could have committed it truncated. Install such a firmware through the official V15.
The update loader is TransitFM1 0.1.3's, byte for byte (answers ota-FM-1_900). The panel and the protocol are 0.1's, the build tested on an FM-1 on 2026-10-18.
TransitFM1's safeguards: ChoralRoot's boot stub, its own update loader (the next firmware's first sector written last), the boot guard; answers every installer as the official V15.
